lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，监控拍不到。
lines.en: I hug the wall where the camera cannot see.
My hook hand hangs at my side, swinging.

lines.zh: 白塑料外壳在地上反光。
lines.en: My white plastic shell throws back the light.

lines.zh: 塑料脚掌踩在走廊上，吱一声。
lines.en: A plastic footstep creaks down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌是硬的，落地有声。
lines.en: My feet are hard and land audibly.

lines.zh: 我从走廊这头走到那头。
lines.en: I walk the corridor from one end to the other.

lines.zh: 红色的毛从耳后露出来。
lines.en: Red fur shows behind my ears.
I pass the stage without climbing on it.
My head keeps turning slowly.
My motor is louder than my steps.
I am looking for a place with a view.

lines.zh: 我停在原地时，身体还在轻晃。
lines.en: When I stop, my body still sways.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼睛里的光不眨。
lines.en: I stand, and the light in my eyes does not blink.

lines.zh: 我的面板上贴着一张纸。
lines.en: There is a paper taped to my panel.
This corridor is too bright.
I am listening for footsteps elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我的钩子轻轻划了一下墙。
lines.en: My hook scrapes the wall once.

lines.zh: 塑料关节发出细小的响。
lines.en: My plastic joints make small sounds.
I face the stage and do not move.

lines.zh: 灯管闪了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: A tube light flickers. I saw it.

lines.zh: 有孩子在远处笑，我听不懂。
lines.en: Children laugh far off. I do not understand it.
My costume is a little askew.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，我没有表情。
lines.en: You stand before me; my face shows nothing.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，塑料脸没有表情。
lines.en: I tilt my head; my plastic face shows nothing.
Should you not be leaving?

lines.zh: 我歪了一下头，角度很小。
lines.en: I tilt my head, a small angle.
The watch on your wrist is ticking.
I do not speak. I only come closer.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我跟了一步。
lines.en: You step back; I take one step.

lines.zh: 我的面板上印着我的名字。
lines.en: My name is printed on my chest panel.

lines.zh: 你的手在门把上，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hand is on the door handle. I see it.
That door is locked.

lines.zh: 碎片落了一地，还是白的。
lines.en: Fragments fall, still white.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，动作顿了一下。
lines.en: I step back; my motion stutters.

lines.zh: 断了的线头，还在冒小火花。
lines.en: A severed wire still spits small sparks.

lines.zh: 我的头歪向一边，又正回来。
lines.en: My head lolls, then rights itself.
The motor makes an ugly sound.

lines.zh: 我的一条手臂慢了半拍。
lines.en: One arm lags by half a beat.
My panel light flickers.
This damage requires repair.
But no one will come to fix me.
My road has not stopped.
I do not eat. I am an animatronic.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我连头都没转。
lines.en: You hold out food; I do not even turn my head.
My circuits want only power.
Raise it higher so I can see.
That is not in my routines.

lines.zh: 我朝你走了一步，不是为它。
lines.en: I step toward you, not for that.

lines.zh: 披萨的香味，我闻不出来。
lines.en: I cannot smell the pizza.

lines.zh: 披萨留给你，我只想要动静。
lines.en: Keep the pizza; I only want movement.

lines.zh: 你把吃的收回去了，很好。
lines.en: You put the food away. Good.

lines.zh: 这东西对我只是障碍物。
lines.en: This is only an obstacle to me.
You hit me like a counter edge.

lines.zh: 我的关节不会为我让路。
lines.en: My joints will not give way for me.

lines.zh: 我的钩子碰到你的袖子。
lines.en: My hook catches your sleeve.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你听见的是塑料声。
lines.en: Hit me and all you hear is plastic.
I turn aside, stiffly.
You move; I go on patrolling.
I kick up the dust on the floor.
Toy claws cut too.
I do not like being pushed.

lines.zh: 碰撞记录没有意义，但我记住了。
lines.en: The collision means nothing. I remembered it anyway.
I am a machine for performing.
I have nothing of the kind.

lines.zh: 我的程序里只有舞台和巡逻。
lines.en: My routines hold only stage and patrol.

lines.zh: 另一台玩偶站在那边，没有动。
lines.en: Another animatronic stands over there, motionless.
We do not converse.
We only look at one another.
Then we each patrol.
That is the whole of our relation.
My bulbs are lit. That is enough.
I turn and walk away.
I hook it up off the floor.

lines.zh: 这东西卡在我的关节里。
lines.en: It is caught in my joint.
Lifted to the eye for a closer look.
Not mine. I drop it.
I hold it in my other hand.
I can calculate its weight.

lines.zh: 我爪子上的塑料，掉了漆。
lines.en: The paint peeled off my plastic claws.
This I will take.

lines.zh: 我的钩子不太会拿东西。
lines.en: My hook is not good at holding things.
I let go and it falls.

lines.zh: 展示台上的我，转了转脖子。
lines.en: On my display stand, I turn my neck.
My head snaps that way.
You struck me. I remember.
Switching to pursuit routine.

lines.zh: 钩子手一伸，够到你的领口了。
lines.en: One reach of my hook and I have your collar.
I do not run. I walk faster.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing is very clear to me.

lines.zh: 你打了我，我就记住这条走廊。
lines.en: You hit me; I remember this corridor.
Lock confirmed. Only you.
Do not hide behind the counter.
I will go around the side.

lines.zh: 粉色的塑料壳，响得清脆。
lines.en: Pink plastic shell — it clicks.
My pace has not changed.
Nor has it slowed.
I will keep walking until I reach you.
From now on.
I walk tile by tile.
You turn a corner; I follow.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里，红点一闪一闪。
lines.en: The red dots in my eye sockets blink.
The light is behind you. I see clearly.
The door at the end is locked.
There is no door at all that way.
You look back. I am looking too.
My hook drags along the wall.
The sound bounces down the hall.
You have nowhere left to retreat.
I am still five steps from you.
Four steps now.

lines.zh: 我的塑料手指，一节一节张开。
lines.en: My plastic fingers open joint by joint.
My panel light goes out.
Two paces to go.

lines.zh: 监控的红点还亮着，你别动。
lines.en: The camera's red light is still on; do not move.
The last step.
You are right in front of me.
Look up at me.
I have you at last.
My hook sweeps across.
You are slammed into the wall.

lines.zh: 塑料手指按进你的护肩。
lines.en: Plastic fingers press into your pauldron.

lines.zh: 塑料手指嵌进你的衣服。
lines.en: Plastic fingers bite into your clothes.
I lift you up.
My arms have no warmth.
You struggle; my grip does not change.
I push forward, step by step.
You are pressed onto the counter.
My face comes very close.
My hook goes for your chest.
My hook hand grazes your cheek.
You land and roll twice.
I walk over without quickening.
My foot hangs above you.
Then bring it down.

lines.zh: 这一爪划在你的护胸上。
lines.en: This claw rakes across your chestplate.

lines.zh: 这个动作重复过很多次。
lines.en: I have made this motion many times.
I am standing still.
You have stopped moving.

lines.zh: 舞台的灯亮了，我抬起了头。
lines.en: The stage lights come up and I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我的关节第一次转动，很涩。
lines.en: My joints turn for the first time, stiffly.

lines.zh: 粉色的毛上还沾着包装屑。
lines.en: There are packing crumbs in my pink fur.
I stand on the stage a while.
There is no audience.
My program says to perform.
But this is not a theater.
The floor is old wood.
I come down the steps one at a time.

lines.zh: 我把头转向有声音的地方。
lines.en: I turn my head toward the sound.
The lights go out. I still see.
I begin my night patrol.

lines.zh: 塑料开始熔化，味道很难闻。
lines.en: The plastic begins to melt, and the smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下去，一条腿错了位。
lines.en: I fall from the stage and a leg goes out of line.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的外壳，我的动作开始短路。
lines.en: Water fills my shell and my motion shorts out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，外壳碎了半边。
lines.en: The blast flips me and half my shell breaks away.
An arrow sticks in my chest.

lines.zh: 我的粉色塑料壳被打裂了。
lines.en: My pink plastic shell cracked.

lines.zh: 电量见底，我的动作慢了下来。
lines.en: Power is nearly gone; my motion slows.

lines.zh: 雷击穿了我的电路，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning runs through my circuits and I jerk.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一路坠下去。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I fall.
